frozen_note: Committed before the first optimization run. Nothing here changes afterwards.
strategy: M5 OB + M1 structure change + M1 FVG retest with a reaction candle (ob_m1_structure.mq5)
fixed_constants_note: N = SwingStrengthM1 = 3 and the 20-point buffer are fixed research constants, approved at the chart gate, not claimed optimal
baseline: variant A (StructureVariant = 0, the code default) with the run_constants risk inputs

series.procedure: per fold, the variant selected on that fold's train window
series.fixed_a: variant A in every fold (the baseline)

holdout_rules: runs once, after the candidate freeze, for variant A and variant B (the candidate is the frozen one of them); reported apart from the WFO; never used to choose parameters, the variant or rules; not an acceptance criterion (R31)

selection.drawdown_metric: the tester's maximum equity drawdown of the train pass
selection.score: recovery factor (net profit / max equity DD), ineligible passes score 0

acceptance.positive_folds_rule: strict majority of the folds evaluated (3 of 5; 2 of 3 for the group R report)
acceptance.net_vs_baseline: the procedure's OOS net must exceed fixed A's
acceptance.risk_metric: loss limits on the daily equity records (eq_min) and MC on daily equity; the train selection uses the tester's maximum equity drawdown

stability.criterion: share of the 4 perturbations with net > 0 >= 0.60: an acceptance criterion of the candidate; the runs are never used for selection (KTD15)

stats.dsr_trials_note: 2 variants x 5 folds + this strategy's pilot runs; the final-train selection, the tick-coverage runs (variant A, single months) and the session probe are not separate trials

reporting.chart_gate: approved by the user (2026-10-04): the 8 charts in results/pilot/gate_package match the agreed rules; the approval covers the examples and the start of the research only
reporting.shared_structure: entries from different OBs on one structure stay allowed (R16, R17, R21 unchanged)
reporting.both_variants: A and B both stay; B is not chosen, no parameter changes and no grid widening because of the exposed pilot results
reporting.drawdowns: every result reports the closed-trade balance drawdown and the tester's equity drawdown apart

session_minute.finding: quotes 01:00, trade session 01:01: SL/TP reached only in the quote-only minute execute from 01:01 (results/pilot/session_probe)
session_minute.sensitivity: research/mt5r/session_sensitivity.py: re-pricing of a fixed trade list at the first trigger tick of the quote-only minute; balance drawdown on the corrected timeline, closed trades only; later sizes, cap slots and signals are not re-simulated; reported for every OOS fold, the WFO aggregate and August-September; never used for a choice

generated_ticks.rule: OOS aggregates for all folds, group G and group R; acceptance also evaluated on group R alone for the report; a difference is stated

reporting.pnl_exposure: results/pilot/gate_decisions.md#pl-exposure-before-the-freeze: pilot net and drawdown of both variants were seen before this freeze; the WFO results are not blind to the researchers
